role: The cauldron: holds water (three levels), fills from a water bucket and fills glass bottles from itself, catches rain, and shrinks by metadata.

members.note: The inside, outside and water icons; the mesh scenes compare every cauldron vertex; render-only: every caller is the client renderer (RenderBlocks, RenderItem, ItemRenderer, RenderGlobal's outline, the item icon and colour hooks); row recordings draw no frames (a frame replay runs it: lane/covframes' frame coverage)

members.name: func_150026_e
members.note: Only the comparator reads it: world.conf redstone = off.

members.name: addCollisionBoxesToList
members.note: The base (0.3125 high) then the four 0.125 walls, each its own box, in that order; the pool box stays the full cube setBlockBoundsForItemRender leaves. details-blocks-s1 drops the player in and walks and jumps it against the walls.

members.name: setBlockBoundsForItemRender
members.note: The item form is the full cube bounds the registry carries.

members.name: onEntityCollidedWithBlock
members.note: COLLIDE_EFFECT_CAULDRON on a server world: a burning entity whose box bottom is at or below y + (6 + 3 * level) / 16 is put out and the level drops by one (flag 2). details-blocks-s1: Fire 42 to -20 while falling in, level 3 to 2.

members.name: onBlockActivated
members.note: The bucket and bottle branches in activate.c; the leather branch in survival.c's surv_server_use_packet (ItemArmor.removeColor on the live stack's display tag, then the level write; the branch does not test hasColor, so an undyed piece empties the cauldron too). details-blocks-s1 washes a red chestplate and empties the cauldron with it.
